en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：

en.text: “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华命定律法中的一条律例乃是这样说：你要吩咐以色列人，把一只没有残疾、未曾负轭、纯红的母牛牵到你这里来，

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華命定律法中的一條律例乃是這樣說：你要吩咐以色列人，把一隻沒有殘疾、未曾負軛、純紅的母牛牽到你這裏來，

en.text: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

zhSimplified.text: 交给祭司以利亚撒；他必牵到营外，人就把牛宰在他面前。

zhTraditional.text: 交給祭司以利亞撒；他必牽到營外，人就把牛宰在他面前。

en.text: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司以利亚撒要用指头蘸这牛的血，向会幕前面弹七次。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司以利亞撒要用指頭蘸這牛的血，向會幕前面彈七次。

en.text: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

zhSimplified.text: 人要在他眼前把这母牛焚烧；牛的皮、肉、血、粪都要焚烧。

zhTraditional.text: 人要在他眼前把這母牛焚燒；牛的皮、肉、血、糞都要焚燒。

en.text: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线都丢在烧牛的火中。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色線都丟在燒牛的火中。

en.text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后可以进营。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後可以進營。

en.text: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

zhSimplified.text: 烧牛的人必不洁净到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。

zhTraditional.text: 燒牛的人必不潔淨到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。

en.text: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

zhSimplified.text: 必有一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，存在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众调做除污秽的水。这本是除罪的。

zhTraditional.text: 必有一個潔淨的人收起母牛的灰，存在營外潔淨的地方，為以色列會眾調做除污穢的水。這本是除罪的。

en.text: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

zhSimplified.text: 收起母牛灰的人必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人作为永远的定例。」

zhTraditional.text: 收起母牛灰的人必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服。這要給以色列人和寄居在他們中間的外人作為永遠的定例。」

en.text: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

zhSimplified.text: 「摸了人死尸的，就必七天不洁净。

zhTraditional.text: 「摸了人死屍的，就必七天不潔淨。

en.text: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

zhSimplified.text: 那人到第三天要用这除污秽的水洁净自己，第七天就洁净了。他若在第三天不洁净自己，第七天就不洁净了。

zhTraditional.text: 那人到第三天要用這除污穢的水潔淨自己，第七天就潔淨了。他若在第三天不潔淨自己，第七天就不潔淨了。

en.text: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the LORD’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

zhSimplified.text: 凡摸了人死尸、不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必从以色列中剪除；因为那除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他就为不洁净，污秽还在他身上。

zhTraditional.text: 凡摸了人死屍、不潔淨自己的，就玷污了耶和華的帳幕，這人必從以色列中剪除；因為那除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他就為不潔淨，污穢還在他身上。

en.text: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

zhSimplified.text: 「人死在帐棚里的条例乃是这样：凡进那帐棚的，和一切在帐棚里的，都必七天不洁净。

zhTraditional.text: 「人死在帳棚裏的條例乃是這樣：凡進那帳棚的，和一切在帳棚裏的，都必七天不潔淨。

en.text: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

zhSimplified.text: 凡敞口的器皿，就是没有扎上盖的，也是不洁净。

zhTraditional.text: 凡敞口的器皿，就是沒有紮上蓋的，也是不潔淨。

en.text: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

zhSimplified.text: 无论何人在田野里摸了被刀杀的，或是尸首，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就要七天不洁净。

zhTraditional.text: 無論何人在田野裏摸了被刀殺的，或是屍首，或是人的骨頭，或是墳墓，就要七天不潔淨。

en.text: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

zhSimplified.text: 要为这不洁净的人拿些烧成的除罪灰放在器皿里，倒上活水。

zhTraditional.text: 要為這不潔淨的人拿些燒成的除罪灰放在器皿裏，倒上活水。

en.text: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

zhSimplified.text: 必当有一个洁净的人拿牛膝草蘸在这水中，把水洒在帐棚上，和一切器皿并帐棚内的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或摸了被杀的，或摸了自死的，或摸了坟墓的那人身上。

zhTraditional.text: 必當有一個潔淨的人拿牛膝草蘸在這水中，把水灑在帳棚上，和一切器皿並帳棚內的眾人身上，又灑在摸了骨頭，或摸了被殺的，或摸了自死的，或摸了墳墓的那人身上。

en.text: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

zhSimplified.text: 第三天和第七天，洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，第七天就使他成为洁净。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就洁净了。

zhTraditional.text: 第三天和第七天，潔淨的人要灑水在不潔淨的人身上，第七天就使他成為潔淨。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就潔淨了。

en.text: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

zhSimplified.text: 「但那污秽而不洁净自己的，要将他从会中剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所。除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。

zhTraditional.text: 「但那污穢而不潔淨自己的，要將他從會中剪除，因為他玷污了耶和華的聖所。除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他是不潔淨的。

en.text: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

zhSimplified.text: 这要给你们作为永远的定例。并且那洒除污秽水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。

zhTraditional.text: 這要給你們作為永遠的定例。並且那灑除污穢水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污穢水的，必不潔淨到晚上。

en.text: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

zhSimplified.text: 不洁净人所摸的一切物就不洁净；摸了这物的人必不洁净到晚上。」

zhTraditional.text: 不潔淨人所摸的一切物就不潔淨；摸了這物的人必不潔淨到晚上。」
